lines.text: Three things to do in Kingston, straight from the airport.
One: the Bob Marley Museum, the house where he lived and recorded many of his songs.
Two: Port Royal, once called the richest and wickedest city on earth.
Three: tour the old fort, then head for Lime Cay and its beaches.
From Norman Manley, the drive runs along the Palisadoes road, with the harbour on one side and the sea on the other.
